Measurements.pageSubtitle: Enter your measurements and let our AI tailor assistant check them for consistency before you order your custom piece.
Measurements.guideSubtitle: For the most accurate result, measure yourself in undergarments with a soft measuring tape, standing straight.

height.title: 1. Height
height.hint: Stand straight against a wall and measure from the floor to the top of your head.

bust.title: 2. Bust (Tour de poitrine)
bust.hint: Wrap the tape around the fullest part of your bust, keeping it level.

waist.title: 3. Waist (Tour de taille)
waist.hint: Measure around the narrowest part of your waist, just above the belly button.

hips.title: 4. Hips (Tour des hanches)
hips.hint: Measure around the fullest part of your hips, about 20cm below your waist.
